steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Keep your own copy of your clients, estimates and invoices, emailed to you on a schedule.

steps.caption: Scheduled exports
steps.narration: In Settings, scroll down to Scheduled exports. Only the owner sees this card.

steps.caption: What is included
steps.narration: An export holds clients, estimates and invoices. Attachments, signed documents and payments are left out.

steps.caption: How often
steps.narration: Choose how often: every week, every two weeks, or your own number of days.

steps.caption: The format
steps.narration: Then the format: three CSV files, or one Excel file with three sheets.

steps.caption: Where it goes
steps.narration: Leave Send to blank and it goes to your company email. Or type another address.

steps.caption: Send export now
steps.narration: You do not have to wait for the schedule. Choose Send export now.

steps.caption: Export sent
steps.narration: A message says how many clients, estimates and invoices went out, and to which address.

steps.caption: Last sent
steps.narration: And the card shows when the last export was sent.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Scheduled exports are in Settings, near the bottom of the left menu.

youtube.title: How to email yourself a scheduled data export | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Keep your own copy of your CRM data. In ConstructHUB CRM Settings, switch on Scheduled exports, choose how often and in which format, and send one right away. An export holds clients, estimates and invoices. Recorded in a demo workspace.
